item.title: Magiclean Stain Mold Bathroom Kitchen Toilet Bleach Glass Cleaner Trigger / Refill, Assorted
item.description:
Price For 1 Bottle

MAGICLEAN BATHROOM CLEANER: Magiclean Bathroom Cleaner makes cleaning the bathroom an absolute breeze! Formulated with instant stain-dissolving foam power developed by advanced Japan R&D, the new and improved formula has 50% increased cleansing power and also dissolves away soap scum without scrubbing! MAGICLEAN BATHROOM & TOILET CLEANER: Magiclean Bathroom & Toilet Cleaner keeps your bathroom looking as good as it smells! Formulated with instant stain-dissolving foam power developed by advanced Japan R&D, it effectively dissolves away tough dirt with a lasting shine while leaving behind a fresh lavender fragrance! MAGICLEAN DUAL POWER TOILET CLEANER: Formulated with Japan Advanced R&D, Magiclean Dual Power Toilet Cleaner not only cleans by effectively disintegrating and dissolving stains and bacteria, it also prevents stains from accumulating on your toilet bowl by leaving behind a protective shield that lasts for up to 60 flushes. It is so effective, even the family will notice the difference! MAGICLEAN GLASS CLEANER: Keep all glass surfaces around the house crystal clear without any watermark left behind with Magiclean Glass Cleaner. Spritz and wipe — it’s that simple! MAGICLEAN KITCHEN CLEANER: Combat the spills, stains and grime around your kitchen with Magiclean Kitchen Cleaners! Formulated with instant stain-dissolving Foam Power developed by advanced Japan R&D for powerful removal of greasy stains in just 30 seconds! MAGICLEAN KITCHEN CLEANER NATURAL: Containing 100% plant derived non-ionic surfactants, it is tough on oily stains yet gentle on the skin. Its special formulation is also free from strong chemical smells, with no added colourants or toxic chemicals, making it gentle enough to clean multiple surfaces. Simply spray and wipe off! MAGICLEAN STAIN & MOLD REMOVER: Did you know that black stains in your bathroom are actually caused by mold? Mold is a fungus that grows in environments with long exposure to moisture, typically in bathrooms. Mold grows by extending roots into surface matters, and most ordinary cleaners are unable to remove them effectively. Magiclean Stain & Mold Remover is formulated with a strong penetrative foam formula that destroys mold roots completely vs regular cleaners, ensuring effective clean without the need for scrubbing. It also kills germs and prevents mold growth3 with regular usage. All in 5 minutes! Just spray and rinse. MAGICLEAN TOILET BLEACH POWER CLEANER: 2 minutes is all it takes to get rid of all stains and bacteria; even the toughest of stains cannot escape the power of bleach. No need to scrub, just flush to restore your toilet bowl to its shiny and clean state. Improved curved neck design also ensures easy application even on the inner rims of the toilet bowl.
